# Harpies
An avian humanoid species that features colorful feathered wings and tails that can mimic almost any sound.
They are quite sensitive to the air quality, and when will begin suffocating due to poor air quality much quicker than others.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Very fast in zero-G, but struggle with precise control. - Uses their talons to deal Piercing damage. - Can imitate around 70% of the game's sound library through a huge list of voice emotes. - They can "Sing" midis by imitating instruments. Right click yourself to select an instrument.
## Special
- While singing, musical notes appear floating around their head.
## Drawbacks
- Takes 15% more Blunt, Slash, and Piercing damage. - Extreme low density, Harpies weigh half as much as a Human. - A Harpy breathes in air twice as often as Humans, inhaling and exhaling every 2 seconds. - - Air tanks last half as long and Harpies are more susceptible than usual to low air quality. - - If a Harpy is exposed to at least 0.6 moles of combined CO2 and/or NH3, they start asphyxiating.
